consumer: The frontend status panel renderer that reads the snapshot's avatar scalars and asks 'what raw stamina/pain value do I show?'; no engine predicate/condition/mission consumes it.
scope: The avatar's own scalar state only (Character::get_stamina / get_pain) — not inventory, not a map region.
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_avatar (scalars) — its body writes ctx.u.get_stamina() and ctx.u.get_pain() straight from the engine getters into the snapshot JSON with no formatting/filtering view in between.
divergence: Set avatar stamina to 3200 via the engine while a cached/re-derived value still reads the old max; the panel showing the stale number instead of the live raw get_stamina() proves the wrong authority.
